key_insight: The paper shows that agentic AI can help formally build and verify Shor-style quantum attack proofs in Lean, extending the formalization to RSA-2048 and P-256 resource estimates.
engineering_relevance: It suggests a practical path for machine-checked quantum cryptanalysis workflows that can support future verification of quantum algorithms and their security implications.
method: Agentic system searches sources, writes Lean code, and repairs proofs.
Human reviewers validate the scientific claims while Lean checks the formal proofs.
Formalizes order finding plus reversible quantum arithmetic for RSA-2048 and P-256 resource analysis.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports formalization of Shor’s algorithm family in Lean and resource estimates for RSA-2048 and P-256 based on prior literature, with additional classical-operation estimates.
watch_item: The results depend on the correctness of the underlying formal assumptions and the fidelity of the resource models, so implementation details and scope should be checked carefully.
paper_title: Building Shor's Algorithm in Lean: An Agentic Formalization of Quantum Attacks on RSA-2048 and P-256
